capability.description: CARIN Blue Button 2.2.0 server: C4BB Coverage

test.name: Refuses Coverage with more than 1 identifier:memberid
test.description: C4BB Coverage allows at most 1 of slice Coverage.identifier:memberid. 2 are refused.

test.name: Refuses Coverage without subscriberId
test.description: C4BB Coverage requires Coverage.subscriberId (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses Coverage without relationship
test.description: C4BB Coverage requires Coverage.relationship (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses Coverage with more than 1 payor
test.description: C4BB Coverage allows at most 1 Coverage.payor; base FHIR allows any number. 2 of them are refused.

test.name: Refuses Coverage with more than 1 class:group
test.description: C4BB Coverage allows at most 1 of slice Coverage.class:group. 2 are refused.

test.name: Refuses Coverage with more than 1 class:plan
test.description: C4BB Coverage allows at most 1 of slice Coverage.class:plan. 2 are refused.

operation.description: Delete Coverage resources created in test.
